capabilities: Generate, edit and upscale images from prompts, selections or embedded images
Generate videos, speech and music and embed the files in notes
Transcribe embedded audio files and insert the transcript underneath
Summarize, rewrite, translate or continue writing with LLM models
Run any catalog model or project workflow through auto-built forms
extras: Each model run is charged per use to the linked Wiro AI account; dialogs show the price before running and a history panel tracks costs. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run image, video, speech, music or text AI models and embed their outputs directly in notes.
summary: AI toolkit that generates images, videos, speech and music, transcribes audio, and summarizes or rewrites text using Wiro AI models, saving results in notes.
